$comment: SchemaStore-style catalog mapping user-authored Aggrega YAML files to the fetch URL of their JSON Schema, for editor schema association (e.g. a YAML language server). The `url` is the SERVED location on the hub (https://hub.aggrega.ai/schemas/<filename>, served as-is from this repo's json/ directory) — NOT the schema's `$id` (https://aggrega.ai/schemas/<name>), which is an identity only and is never served. Source of truth is this repo's json/; the hub copies are published as-is (never forked). Covers user-authored kinds only — the internal/machine schemas (ir, lockfile, plugins-trust, cache-metadata, template-context, path-template-context, wasm-*) are not authored by hand and are intentionally absent. fileMatch globs are the initial association set, biased to the standard-catalog directory layout and the conventional per-version entity filenames; consumers may also pin per file with a `# yaml-language-server: $schema=<url>` modeline.
